query:
WITH activated AS (
  UPDATE pending_roles pr
  SET deleted_at = NOW()
  FROM user_details ud
  WHERE ud.user_id = $1
    AND ud.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL
    AND lower(pr.user_email) = lower(ud.email)
    AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND pr.expires_at > NOW()
  RETURNING pr.role,
    pr.organization_id,
    pr.course_id,
    pr.course_instance_id,
    pr.exam_id,
    pr.is_global
),
granted AS (
  INSERT INTO roles (
      user_id,
      role,
      organization_id,
      course_id,
      course_instance_id,
      exam_id,
      is_global
    )
  SELECT DISTINCT $1::uuid,
    a.role,
    a.organization_id,
    a.course_id,
    a.course_instance_id,
    a.exam_id,
    a.is_global
  FROM activated a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM roles r
      WHERE r.user_id = $1
        AND r.role = a.role
        AND r.organization_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.organization_id
        AND r.course_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.course_id
        AND r.course_instance_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.course_instance_id
        AND r.exam_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.exam_id
        AND r.is_global = a.is_global
        AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
FROM granted
